directive.thread_id: film repository port 2026-11-05, lane film-tools: the narrator tools of a film
directive.quote: Finish the port of the film repository so it can be retired: move each job to its correct home, porting the correct parts one to one and never rebuilding from scratch what already worked; move the code byte for byte, then make what it fixed arguments and settings.

targets.baseline_commit_message: fill-a-template-without-changing-its-words: a film's hand-written token table and slot-variant writer, moved byte for byte

preserve: every word of the kept and slot parts becomes one token marked KEEP or SLOT, in order, ids <unit>/speech/<n>
a slot token carries its slot, type, note and slot dims; only slots a word uses are listed
the word-template@1 shape: piece, registry, one unit, one line, slots, tokens, empty fills, pending drift.status, notes
allowed_deltas: the templates (words, times, sources, slots), the registry path and the dimension are the request's, read from the person's list:settings row with tools/settings request_settings (read-data/request_files.py), instead of the script's tables
medium, kind, reader and the maker named in provenance are request fields with the old values as defaults
one JSON answer as the last line; refusals say what to change
banned_substitutions: a second token-table writer beside make_template.py's shape
a person's words written into the code
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it. Lines holding a person's name or a private path are left out of the sources (each source names its lines), so they never reach this public repository; the first source is the byte copy. The source is build() (lines 17-45); the rest of the file was one film's data (four reference intros and its own opening), now the person's settings rows.
